nodes.label: Companies Screen — CRM Module
nodes.description: CRM Companies list page showing 6 companies in a table. Columns: Company, Industry, Location, Employees, Website. Actions: Template, Import CSV, Export CSV, Add Company, Edit per row. Sidebar navigation: CRM (Pipeline, Contacts, Companies, Tasks, Activity), Infrastructure (Servers, Databases, Websites, Files), General (Analytics, Alerts, Settings). Top alert bar shows 3 active alerts (prod-worker-01 memory critical). App brand: Vantage Test.
